item.title: Formula E signs landmark Disney+ deal to stream championship in 144 territories
item.summary: Formula E is set for a major global push as Disney+ becomes the championship's new streaming home from the 2026/27 season. Under a new multi-year deal, fans in 144 territories will be able to watch every Formula E race weekend live on Disney+, including practice, qualifying and races. In the US, the championship will also stream on ESPN+, bringing the electric racing series to millions of new fans.
